caption: The drawing contains three stylized deer depicted in profile and arranged vertically on a light beige background. At the top, there is a brown deer outlined in red with a blue eye and blue antlers decorated with yellow shapes. In the middle, a blue deer with red antlers and accents, white hooves, and a pattern of yellow scallops on its body is facing left with its legs extended as if leaping. At the bottom, there is a red deer outlined in red with blue highlights on its hooves and antlers, and a yellow and blue wavy stripe running along its side and neck. The overall composition is clean, with each deer separated by ample space, and the drawing utilizes flat, solid colors without shading. Below the deer, there is text reading, "FROM CERAMICS AND ILLUMINATED WRITINGS 1773 TO 1811," and further information identifying the origin as Pennsylvania German folk art.
title: Drawing for Plate 3: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
